rationale: Medical applications require warmth, calm, and trust. A stark white or heavy dark mode can feel too clinical, cold, or disconnected from the human element. By utilizing soft sage greens, bone-whites, and earthy terracotta accents, we foster a sense of safety and organic care for both patients and doctors.

headings.rationale: Soft Utility – Friendly, clear, and modern without being overly corporate.

scales.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tight leading-tight font-bold
scales.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl tracking-tight leading-snug font-semibold

body.rationale: Highly legible, geometric, and functional, perfect for dense medical data and transcriptions.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing (p-6, p-8, p-12) to avoid medical interface clutter.
spacing_and_layout.border_radius: rounded-2xl for main containers, rounded-xl for inner widgets. Subtle roundness.
spacing_and_layout.grid_pattern: MODE B (The Control Room Grid) for the dashboard/results view. Use tight gaps (gap-6) but generous inner padding.
spacing_and_layout.alignment: Left-align paragraphs, transcripts, and structured medical data for clarity. Center hero sections gently.

surfaces_and_microthemes.cards: Flat solid surfaces with a delicate 1px border (border-border/60). No heavy shadows to prevent distraction. Ambient shadow-sm on hover.
surfaces_and_microthemes.headers: Crystal Glassmorphism (bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-white/20) for floating navigation.
surfaces_and_microthemes.medical_data_areas: Use flat solid surfaces ONLY (no glass) to prevent visual refraction of data and maintain maximum legibility.

components.strategy: Use Shadcn UI components but heavily customize their border radii and colors to match the Organic & Earthy archetype.
components.buttons: Primary buttons use #4A5D4E with white text. Hover states must be explicitly set (e.g., hover:bg-[#38523A]).
components.inputs: Shadcn Form, Input, and Textarea. Focus states must have a 2px ring of the primary color (focus:ring-[#4A5D4E]).
components.icons: lucide-react (default choice, already installed, clean and modern).
components.interactions: All interactive elements MUST have explicit hover, active, and focus states.

motion.state_transitions: transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out for buttons and inputs.
motion.loading: Use gentle pulse animations rather than frantic spinners for processing states to maintain a calm environment.
motion.lists: Staggered fade-ins for history list items.

hero_doctor_consultation.description: Woman in white scrub suit holding gray laptop computer, consulting with a patient. Use for landing page hero or about section.

abstract_background.description: Abstract patterned texture with organic shapes (Sage green). Use for login page background or decorative accents.

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow the exact sequence of phases described in the Master Build Plan.
Implement the UI using Next.js App Router, Tailwind CSS, and shadcn/ui components.
Ensure the recording interaction strict 120s timer is clearly visible and updates state accordingly (idle -> recording -> uploading -> processing).
For the /result/[id] page, implement a clear 'Bento' grid splitting raw transcript, translation, and structured prescription.

CRITICAL: Add 'data-testid' attributes to all interactive and key informational elements (buttons, inputs, status indicators) using kebab-case role-based naming (e.g., 'data-testid="record-start-button"').
Use the mock LLM implementation for structured prescription extraction in V1.
Do not use transparent backgrounds over content without a blur/scrim. Use the defined glassmorphism or solid colors.
Ensure text contrast meets APCA/WCAG standards, especially in the #FDFBF7 and #FFFFFF surfaces.
